e8d18375d12b.title: Assured AI programme: act on bean drift
e8d18375d12b.content: Process_AAI_BeanDrift · strict (defaulted) · 4 step(s) . Keep the programme issues and the beans they carry from drifting apart. The issue owns the programme fields, dates, review and epic; the bean owns the steps and their execution; neither copies the other. The drift check compares them and flags; a person decides what changes (req:aai-design-principles#DP-06). i i i i

8bda46da396a.doc: Assured AI programme: triage a bean
8bda46da396a.title: Assured AI programme: triage a bean
8bda46da396a.content: Process_AAI_BeanTriage · strict (defaulted) · 2 step(s) . Decide what an open bean is to the programme. Beans are how work is done, in whichever repository does it; programme issues are how the programme sees it. A bean gets an issue when it delivers part of an epic, changes a date, creates or clears a cross-workstream dependency, or needs a human review or decision. Otherwise it stays a bean. The issue is the record of the link, by a hidden line in its body, <!-- bean: owner/repo/id -->; nothing in the bean’s repository is written. i i

f1bcfdaf7d47.content: Every one of the 7 diagrams has a rendered SVG. Activities carrying no <bootstrap.processes:skill ref> — a census, not a gap list . 38 across 7 diagram(s). No verdict is offered on which of these is a gap, and that is the honest state rather than a hedge: distinguishing a person’s judgement step from an agent step somebody forgot needs the lane’s actor KIND, which a free-text lane name does not give — process-model.ts notes sixty lanes spell two dozen positions. The lane’s partitionElementRef is the join that would answer it, and it is present on 35 of these 35 steps — which is the measurement, not an impression. An earlier draft of this sentence said few of these and was counting whether the lane had a NAME, a different question with a different answer.
